# HarDNet-68

Classification · `hardnet68_224x224` · DX-APP C++ example

Classification model, evaluated on ImageNet (ILSVRC2012).

**Input** 224 × 224 × 3 · **Dataset** ImageNet (ILSVRC2012) · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![HarDNet-68 output](../../../../python_example/image_classification/hardnet/hardnet68_224x224/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/image_classification/hardnet/hardnet68_224x224/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models HarDNet68
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target hardnet68_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/hardnet68_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/hardnet68_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/hardnet/hardnet68_224x224/hardnet68_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/hardnet68_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 76.47 |
| Q-Lite | 76.18 (−0.29) |
| Q-Pro | 76.48 (+0.01) |
